import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a 2x2 subplot layout
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
fraud_colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
fraud_by_type = pd.crosstab(df['transaction_type'], df['is_fraud'])
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=fraud_colors, width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Fraud Distribution by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax1.legend(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], title='Transaction Status')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution by fraud status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
legitimate = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
fraud = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
ax2.hist([legitimate, fraud], bins=30, label=['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], 
         color=fraud_colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud rate by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day').agg({
    'is_fraud': ['sum', 'count']
}).reset_index()
hourly_fraud.columns = ['hour_of_day', 'fraud_count', 'total_count']
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = (hourly_fraud['fraud_count'] / hourly_fraud['total_count']) * 100

ax3.plot(hourly_fraud['hour_of_day'], hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], 
         marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='#e74c3c')
ax3.fill_between(hourly_fraud['hour_of_day'], hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], 
                  alpha=0.3, color='#e74c3c')
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Box plot of amounts by fraud status and transaction type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_status'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_status', 
            ax=ax4, palette=fraud_colors)
ax4.set_title('Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.legend(title='Status')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
